text:
samir: Opened PR to refresh the onboarding quickstart: adds a DevContainer + Codespaces note, localdev hot-reload example, modern SDK8 async snippets, and clarifies auth rotation. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1102
elsa: Love the devcontainer addition. Can you list the snippet changes so reviewers can focus?
samir: Sure: 1) python sync -> async; 2) node top-level await with module note + CommonJS fallback; 3) replace sed with cross-platform Node/Python one-liner; 4) add ephemeral key snippet and short rotation note; 5) DevContainer devserver hot-reload section.
docs-bot: CI started for PR #1102: running build, linkcheck, snippet-tests, devcontainer lint.
ray: Quick found one: curl example uses `Auth:` header. Should be `Authorization: Bearer <API_KEY>`. Small but common error.
samir: Fixing that now. Also adding an inline example for ephemeral keys: `export RW_API_KEY=$(curl -s "https://api.redwood-inference.dev/ephemeral?scopes=generate")` and a one-liner note about TTL.
yara: For Codespaces/devcontainer note, can we mention port forwarding and the default forwarded port 8080? Some users get tripped by Docker vs sample app port.
elsa: Also the Dockerfile in the quickstart exposed 3000 but the app listens on 8080. Please align and add a short comment about env var injection in cloud builds.
samir: Adjusted Dockerfile to EXPOSE 8080 and added a small note about build-time vs runtime envs. Pushing commit.
docs-bot: snippet-tests failed on macOS runner: the setup snippet uses `sed -i 's/PLACEHOLDER/${RW_API_KEY}/' config` which fails. Log: https://ci.redwood-inference.internal/1102/snippet-log.
ray: We should avoid sed for portability. Suggest replacing with: `node -e "const fs=require('fs');fs.writeFileSync('config',fs.readFileSync('config.tpl','utf8').replace('PLACEHOLDER',process.env.RW_API_KEY||''))"` and add a short comment "requires node or python".
yara: Or provide both Node and Python options in a 1-line block and label them cross-platform.
samir: Added both options and a brief comment. Also switched the DevContainer example to use the pre-built image with `forwardPorts: [8080]` and a small RSVP about Codespaces secrets. Pushed update.
docs-bot: snippet-tests retriggered and passed except for a shellcheck warning in entrypoint.sh.
elsa: Shellcheck wants `if [ -n "${RW_API_KEY:-}" ]` instead of unguarded var. Small fix.
samir: Fixed script and updated the small troubleshooting FAQ with two bullets: "missing header" and "expired/ephemeral key" and linked to /security/kms for rotation/HSM.
docs-bot: Linkcheck failed: redirect from /integrations/kms to /security/kms. Adjusted link to canonical path and re-run.
ray: One UX nit: wording for ephemeral keys is a bit heavy. Can we shorten to 1 sentence plus an example? New devs skim.
yara: Agreed. Also add a short callout for platform customers about automated rotation via KMS and mention env-var reloaders (systemd, supervisor, or k8s secrets) for zero-downtime swaps.
samir: Simplified ephemeral blurb, added the KMS pointer and zero-downtime tip. Pushed.
docs-bot: All checks passed for PR #1102. Build succeeded and the site deploy to staging started.
elsa: I'll sanity-check staging and run the quickstart in Codespaces to verify the forwarded port and secrets flow.
ray: I ran the quickstart locally with the devcontainer and verified hot-reload and auth flow. Left one tiny wording tweak on the staging site branch (clarified "hot-reload" steps). Pushed micro-fix.
docs-bot: Site deploy to staging completed.
elsa: Verified staging. Ephemeral example works and the FAQ covers the common auth errors we get in support. Approving now.
samir: Merging after a final second of CI green. Thanks team :tada:
docs-bot: PR #1102 merged and deployed to main.
samir: Closing thread. If any follow-ups, please open a new PR for additional devcontainer templates or Codespaces tips. Thanks again.
